heroText: Your generosity helps House of Bread Ministries share the gospel and serve people in practical ways in our community and beyond.
whyTitle: Honor God with what He has entrusted to us.
whyText1: We believe everything we have ultimately comes from God. Giving is one way we respond with gratitude, worship, and faith.
whyText2: Proverbs 3:9–10 calls believers to honor the Lord with the firstfruits of their increase. Through faithful generosity, the church can feed, support, teach, reach, and serve.
zelleText: Send tithes and offerings using houseofbreadworship@gmail.com. First-time givers should include their name and contact information for receipting.
inPersonText: Give during any worship service. Envelopes are available for tithes, offerings, and special gifts.
mailText: Mail checks or money orders to House of Bread Ministries, 335 South 4th Avenue, Mount Vernon, NY 10550.
